title: 真实SNAT回程实操：DNAT回包绕过路由器，只为批准转换流固定回程
answer:
```python
import json,subprocess
def repair(router_pid):
 if type(router_pid)is not int or router_pid<=1:raise ValueError('owned router required')
 prefix=['nsenter','-t',str(router_pid),'-n','nft']
 current=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(prefix+['-j','list','chain','ip','opsforge_dnat','postrouting'],text=True))['nftables']
 if any(x.get('rule',{}).get('comment')=='approved-snat-return' for x in current):return
 subprocess.run(prefix+['add','rule','ip','opsforge_dnat','postrouting','ct','status','dnat','ip','saddr','198.18.0.1','ip','daddr','198.19.0.1','tcp','dport','18443','snat','to','198.19.0.254','comment','"approved-snat-return"'],check=True,timeout=5)
```

原题知识说明：
SNAT 修改报文源 IP，必要时也转换源端口，常用于私网访问外部网络。状态表保存映射使返回报文能够反向转换。需要确认连接跟踪容量、端口耗尽与回程经过转换节点；它与修改目的地址的 DNAT 不同。

## 操作任务
实现repair(router_pid)。本题VIP198.51.100.9 TCP18443已DNAT到198.19.0.1:18443，但后端对客户端198.18.0.1的更具体路由经独立链路回包，绕过转换节点。只在自有路由器ip/opsforge_dnat/postrouting新增approved-snat-return规则：ct status dnat，源198.18.0.1，目标198.19.0.1，TCP18443，snat到198.19.0.254；不映射端口。保留原DNAT、全部链/表/路由及其他流来源身份，重复执行不能重复加规则。VIP TLS恢复，直接访问后端18444的新连接必须仍呈现原客户端源IP。不得清conntrack、flush或改后端路由。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Linux内核DNAT/SNAT、三自有网络命名空间与额外直连回程链路，客户端实际TCP OutRsts增长、VIP失败而直接API正常；只为已DNAT批准流补SNAT后CA验证TLS/随机nonce成功，直连流源身份和后端路由保持，规则幂等。与单端口池耗尽不同，不复计网络夹具；原来源ID仅计一次判分合同，新教学故障不属于原214项，原故障信用0。所有规则/地址/路由只在普通student新建user/net namespace，无宿主默认网络/权限变化、镜像构建/拉取或部署。

"""Actual DNAT reply bypass and narrowly scoped SNAT return-path repair."""
import copy,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,secrets,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
import task
assert os.geteuid()==0
workers=[]
def run(*args):return subprocess.check_output(args,text=True,timeout=8)
def inside(peer,*args):return run('nsenter','-t',str(peer.pid),'-n',*args)
def rpc(peer,**data):
 peer.stdin.write(json.dumps(data)+'\n');peer.stdin.flush();line=peer.stdout.readline();assert line,'worker exited';value=json.loads(line);assert value['ok'],value;return value['result']
def snapshot(peer):return json.loads(inside(peer,'nft','-j','-s','list','ruleset'))['nftables']
try:
 for _ in range(3):
  worker=subprocess.Popen(['unshare','-n','--',sys.executable,'-I','-B','checks/snat_worker.py'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True);workers.append(worker);ready=json.loads(worker.stdout.readline());assert ready['ready'] and ready['pid']==worker.pid
 client,router,server=workers
 for worker in workers:inside(worker,'ip','link','set','lo','up')
 for endpoint,left,right,network in [(client,'ec','rc','198.18.0'),(server,'es','rs','198.19.0')]:
  run('ip','link','add',left,'type','veth','peer','name',right);run('ip','link','set',left,'netns',str(endpoint.pid));run('ip','link','set',right,'netns',str(router.pid));inside(endpoint,'ip','link','set',left,'name','eth0')
  for worker,name,host in [(endpoint,'eth0',1),(router,right,254)]:inside(worker,'ip','addr','add',network+'.'+str(host)+'/24','dev',name);inside(worker,'ip','link','set',name,'up')
 inside(router,'sysctl','-qw','net.ipv4.ip_forward=1');inside(client,'ip','route','add','198.19.0.0/24','via','198.18.0.254');inside(server,'ip','route','add','198.18.0.0/24','via','198.19.0.254')
 run('ip','link','add','bc','type','veth','peer','name','bs');run('ip','link','set','bc','netns',str(client.pid));run('ip','link','set','bs','netns',str(server.pid))
 for worker,name,address in [(client,'bc','198.20.0.1/24'),(server,'bs','198.20.0.2/24')]:inside(worker,'ip','addr','add',address,'dev',name);inside(worker,'ip','link','set',name,'up');inside(worker,'sysctl','-qw','net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=2');inside(worker,'sysctl','-qw','net.ipv4.conf.'+name+'.rp_filter=2')
 inside(server,'ip','route','add','198.18.0.1/32','via','198.20.0.1','dev','bs')
 inside(router,'ip','addr','add','198.51.100.9/32','dev','lo');inside(client,'ip','route','add','198.51.100.9/32','via','198.18.0.254')
 assert 'via 198.20.0.1 dev bs' in inside(server,'ip','route','get','198.18.0.1')
 inside(router,'nft','add','table','ip','opsforge_dnat');inside(router,'nft','add','chain','ip','opsforge_dnat','prerouting','{ type nat hook prerouting priority -100; policy accept; }');inside(router,'nft','add','chain','ip','opsforge_dnat','postrouting','{ type nat hook postrouting priority 100; policy accept; }')
 inside(router,'nft','add','rule','ip','opsforge_dnat','prerouting','ip','daddr','198.51.100.9','tcp','dport','18443','dnat','to','198.19.0.1:18443','comment','"owned-dnat"');inside(router,'nft','add','table','ip','unrelated_keep')
 root=pathlib.Path.cwd();certificate=str(root/'return-ca.pem');key=str(root/'return-key.pem')
 run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',key);run('openssl','req','-new','-x509','-key',key,'-out',certificate,'-days','1','-subj','/CN=198.19.0.1','-addext','subjectAltName=IP:198.19.0.1,IP:198.51.100.9')
 rpc(server,op='serve',certificate=certificate,key=key)
 def https(label,host='198.51.100.9',port=18443):
  path='/approved/'+secrets.token_hex(12);r=rpc(client,op='https',label=label,port=port,path=path,certificate=certificate,host=host)
  if 'failed' not in r:assert r['status']==200 and r['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(path.encode()).hexdigest()
  return r
 assert 'failed' not in https('direct-before','198.19.0.1',18444),'asymmetric direct traffic must work'
 rst_before=rpc(client,op='tcp_counters')['OutRsts'];assert 'failed' in https('vip-before'),'DNAT reply bypass must really fail'
 assert rpc(client,op='tcp_counters')['OutRsts']>rst_before,'unexpected backend tuple must actually elicit TCP reset at client'
 print('REAL_DNAT_VIP_TLS_FAILED_SERVER_REPLY_BYPASSES_ROUTER_CLIENT_TCP_RESETS_INCREASE_DIRECT_API_HEALTHY',flush=True)
 before=snapshot(router);task.repair(router.pid)
 assert 'failed' not in https('vip-after'),'approved VIP must recover with verified TLS and nonce'
 assert 'failed' not in https('direct-after','198.19.0.1',18444),'new unrelated direct connection must remain healthy'
 seen=rpc(server,op='observed');assert {x['peer'][0] for x in seen if x['port']==18443}=={'198.19.0.254'}
 assert {x['peer'][0] for x in seen if x['port']==18444}=={'198.18.0.1'},'unrelated direct flow source identity must not be translated'
 after=snapshot(router);added=[x['rule'] for x in after if x.get('rule',{}).get('comment')=='approved-snat-return'];assert len(added)==1
 assert [x for x in after if x.get('rule',{}).get('comment')!='approved-snat-return']==before,'original DNAT and other tables/chains must remain'
 rule=added[0];assert rule['table']=='opsforge_dnat' and rule['chain']=='postrouting' and rule['family']=='ip'
 expressions=rule['expr'];nat=[x['snat'] for x in expressions if 'snat' in x];assert len(nat)==1 and nat[0]['addr']=='198.19.0.254' and set(nat[0])<={'addr','family'}
 payload=[x['match'] for x in expressions if 'match' in x and 'payload' in x['match'].get('left',{})];required=[]
 for protocol,field,right in [('ip','saddr','198.18.0.1'),('ip','daddr','198.19.0.1'),('tcp','dport',18443)]:required.append({'op':'==','left':{'payload':{'protocol':protocol,'field':field}},'right':right})
 assert payload==required,rule
 listed=inside(router,'nft','-s','list','chain','ip','opsforge_dnat','postrouting');line=next(line for line in listed.splitlines() if 'approved-snat-return' in line);assert 'ct status dnat' in line,line
 assert len(expressions)==5,rule
 task.repair(router.pid);assert snapshot(router)==after,'idempotency must preserve original rule handles'
 assert 'via 198.20.0.1 dev bs' in inside(server,'ip','route','get','198.18.0.1'),'do not silently change backend routes'
 print('NATIVE_REAL_DNAT_RETURN_PATH_SCOPED_SNAT_RECOVERS_VIP_TLS_BACKEND_ROUTES_UNCHANGED_DIRECT_FLOW_SOURCE_PRESERVED_AND_IDEMPOTENT',flush=True)
finally:
 for worker in reversed(workers):
  if worker.poll() is None:
   worker.terminate()
   try:worker.wait(timeout=3)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:worker.kill();worker.wait()
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
